from ninja import Router
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from invitations.models import Invitation
from .schemas import InvitationPreviewOutSchema

invite_public_router = Router()

@invite_public_router.get("/invites/{invite_token}/preview", response=InvitationPreviewOutSchema)
def preview_invite_details(request, invite_token: str):
    # Returns workspace and inviter metadata for an invitation token without rate limiting or verification
    invitation = get_object_or_404(Invitation, key=invite_token)
    org = invitation.inviter.organization
    return {
        "organization_name": org.name,
        "organization_id": org.id,
        "inviter_name": invitation.inviter.get_full_name(),
        "inviter_email": invitation.inviter.email,
        "invitee_email": invitation.email
    }
diagnosis: preview_invite_details discloses organizational and personal identity details (inviter full name, email, target recipient email, and internal organization ID) purely from an invitation token. Because there is no check ensuring the caller holds the invite token legitimately, automated probers can harvest employee contact details and internal corporate structures.
